messages:
nina_pm: Quick announcement: StreamMux + Toolchain v1 is GA on hosted. This includes multiplexed streaming frames, tool/function calling primitives, and the new mosaic-lite-q4 low-cost quantized variant. Rolling out now to standard hosted tiers. :party-parrot:

leo_infra: Congrats! Outline of rollout? canary windows, mirrors, flags?

nina_pm: Rollout plan: 1) 6h internal canary (us-west) w/ mirrored production traffic, 2) 24h region-by-region ramp (EU then APAC), 3) finalize 100% for hosted standard after SRE signoff. Dedicated/private customers get a separate schedule + migration assist.

tess_eng: SDKs published: clients v2.6.1 (npm/pypi). Adds streamMux: true option, parses multiplexed frames and exposes toolcall events. Please pin test harnesses to 2.6.1 for the next 48h.

kai_sre: Ops notes: New header to opt in: X-Redwood-StreamMux: enabled. Legacy X-Stream-Legacy kept for 90 days then removed. Stream sessions count against concurrent-streams quota. Added automatic fallback to mosaic-base on capacity pressure (soft-fail).

docs-bot: Docs published: https://internal.redwood/devdocs/streammux-toolchain (includes migration checklist, sample code, and FAQ).

leo_infra: Perf snapshot from perf-lab: mosaic-lite-q4 ~2.5x token cost savings on short-turn chats; p50 latency up to 1.2x faster at 256-512 tokens. Still running longer-context evals.

tess_eng: Example curl for streaming + toolcall (streams multiplexed frames; client libs recommended):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-StreamMux: enabled" \n  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite-q4","stream":true,"tool_calls":true,"input":"Summarize recent calendar events"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```

deploy-bot: canary keys created: canary-usw-182100 1:47 UTC. Canary deploy started. Logs: /ops/deploys/1821002468

kai_sre: Dashboards & alerts: new panels for streammux traffic, toolcall error rates, and mosaic-lite regressions. Alert if toolcall error rate > 1% for 5m or latency p95 increases by >25%. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/streammux

nina_pm: No quota increases right now. Please report any user-facing regressions in this thread immediately. We'll hold a short post-launch checkin in 12h. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
